name: Multiplayer Edit X
description: Fork of Multiplayer Edit by xXoanon, rebased on the stable 0.5.0 editor/network lifecycle with configurable signaling and TURN connection options.

signaling-url.name: Signaling Server URL
signaling-url.description: URL of the signaling server used for connection setup.

turn-host.name: TURN Host
turn-host.description: Hostname or IPv4 address of the TURN server. Port 3478/UDP is used.

turn-password.name: TURN Password
turn-password.description: TURN password stored locally in Geode settings and never embedded in release builds.

force-turn-relay.name: Force TURN Relay
force-turn-relay.description: Force WebRTC ICE through configured TURN for diagnostics or restrictive networks.

player-name.name: Player Name
player-name.description: Your display name in multiplayer sessions.

show-cursors.name: Show Player Cursors
show-cursors.description: Display other players' cursor positions in the editor.
